Hi Sam —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear list. Confirming the process from Redwood's side:

- Opt-out for model training: We will record BrightFin's opt-out and ensure production data is excluded from any model improvement pipelines. This is a configuration flag at the tenant level; once set we will not use content for training or evaluation.
- Data residency: We can pin BrightFin to us-east-1 for all production inference and logs.
- Logging & retention: Default API request logs are retained for 90 days. We can support a shorter retention window on request and provide a purge run for historical logs (will require scheduling with our infra team).
- Audit evidence: We can provide a signed confirmation (opt-out acceptance), an internal change log entry, and a short attestation PDF that states the configuration changes and retention policy applied.

Next steps I propose:
1) I sign/ack the attached opt-out form and return it to you (please confirm the preferred recipient for countersignatures).
2) Our legal/infosec (cc'ed: marissa_cole) will review any redlines you submit.
3) We schedule a short config call if you want the retention/purge timeline to be accelerated.

Attached: SOW-draft-DF-4523.docx (initial SOW for pilot, includes a clause for opt-out config).

I will sign the opt-out form and send it back by EOD.
